moves.comment: The game opens as a King's Pawn Game (B00).
The game transposes into the French Defense (C00).
This is the last book move of the French Defense: Classical Variation, Delayed Exchange Variation (C11); both sides are on their own from here.

The most accurate move holds the balance (+0.00, Stockfish:16) along [pv:Nf3 a6 a3 Bd6 Bd3], developing the knight while setting White on a line that may open the a-file for the rook—an open file often gives the rook room to penetrate. Bd3 is a comparable option that leads to equality along [pv:Bd3 c5 Nf3 c4 Be2], with the potential to leave Black's pawn structure weaker further down the line.
